statusText: Tail 12% (low), Stress 36% (moderate), Confidence 82% (high). Mapped policy state: EA_ON.
recommendation: Mapped policy state is EA_ON and Tail remains well below the block threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers the U.S. cash open, 13:30-15:00 UTC, where an already-aligned bullish overnight regime historically carries the highest opening-continuation risk. Outside that window the overnight drift is modest and mean reversion has not been denied. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected by this mapping.
headline: Nasdaq-100 extends a modest overnight drift near session highs on crude relief; cross-assets stay unaligned
body: NQ front-month trades 30,151.00, up 0.78% and about 10 points under its 30,161.50 overnight high after a directionally efficient advance from 29,904.00. The 257-point (0.86%) range is modest, so the advance still qualifies as a mild one-way drift rather than a mean-reversion failure, and no failed-retracement sequence has been observed. Cash ^NDX closed Friday at 29,644.17, up 0.67%, at the top of its 29,371.89-29,647.80 range and about 3.6% below the 52-week high of 30,762.20. The supporting impulse is benign: WTI is in a fourth consecutive session of decline on Middle East diplomacy signals, with U.S. Central Command reporting Hormuz oil and LNG flows at six-month highs and a possible Trump-Pezeshkian contact at this week's UN General Assembly; quote sources differ by a few dollars, with Asian-session reporting near $93.6 and Trading Economics' front-month page at $98.00, but the direction is unambiguous. Against that, the macro backdrop is genuinely tight: the Fed delivered a unanimous 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16, its first since 2023, with a dot plot pointing to one more in 2026; the 10-year sits near 5.00% after Friday's 5bp rise and the 2-year at 4.67%. Rising yields alongside rising equities is a conflicting rather than aligned configuration, which supports moderate Stress with Tail in the low band. Delayed latest-session context shows semiconductors leading (MU +3.9%, ARM +4.0%, AVGO +3.0%) against a 5.8% QCOM decline, weaker software and megacaps split four up, four down; that context is not evidence of live price path. VIX closed at 14.81 with no volatility bid into the reopen. The main conditional risk is the 13:30 UTC cash open, where an aligned bullish overnight regime is the pattern that has previously preceded opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks.

lookbackSummary: All 24 of the 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail stayed in a 5-11 band and Stress in a 30-36 band throughout, with every slot mapped to EA_ON and green. Dominant mode was normal for 23 slots and turned trend-up only in the final hour, when the futures advance off 29,904.00 became directionally efficient enough to register. Tail drifted from 5 up to 9 between 22:00 and 01:00 UTC as the reopen set direction, eased back to 5 by 05:00 UTC, then stepped to 11 at 06:00 UTC. Confidence improved steadily from 70 to 81 as overnight evidence accumulated. No slot approached the block threshold.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail inside the low band across all 24 hours, peaking at 17 in the first full hour after the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open, where an aligned bullish overnight regime carries the session's highest opening-continuation risk, then decaying to 9 through the post-close, maintenance-break and Asian hours before ticking back to 10 at Tuesday's European open. Stress peaks near 42 at the open and eases to 33 overnight, staying in the moderate band throughout. Confidence declines with horizon from 82 to 68. Scheduled checkpoints inside the horizon are the 10:30 UTC Goolsbee speech and the 12:30 UTC Chicago Fed activity index; beyond it are Tuesday's Richmond Fed index and Williams and Jefferson speeches, the Sep 23 flash PMIs at 13:45 UTC, claims and new home sales on Sep 24 and durable goods on Sep 25. The Xi state visit to Washington on Sep 24 and possible UN General Assembly contact between Washington and Tehran are the main unscheduled headline levers, with the Nov 10 trade-truce expiry still unresolved.
